dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How come you still haven't graduated?

dialogues.speaker: Hosseini
dialogues.text: ...What do you mean, "still"? I'm not even 30 yet. I'm hardly an exceptional case.

dialogues.speaker: Hosseini
dialogues.text: And anyway, even graduating after the age of 30 is not so uncommon at the Akademiya.

dialogues.speaker: Hosseini
dialogues.text: ...Quit staring at my hair! This is the price one must pay for the pursuit of wisdom!
